thread:
sarah: :rotating_light: Heads up — got reports that some pages for infra oncall never hit the phones this morning. Customer SLOs showing gaps. Anyone seeing missing pages in the incident queue?

incident-bot: automated message: failed delivery attempts: 3 to team infra (reason: mapping not found). retrying with escalation policy fallback.

mike: I saw a missed pager for infra at ~08:12. The incident channel never spawned either, just the failed delivery logs in the notifier.

emma (oncall): I didn't get anything on my phone. I was on rotation and reachable. I only saw the follow-up alert email at 08:18.

josh: digging into the notifier logs now. quick glance shows our oncall cache provider returned a 200 but payload was empty for the infra team mapping. suspecting oncall-service sync issue after last night's rotation change.

ops-sre: can someone paste the error lines? I'm oncall pager bridge for this shift.

josh: sure — log excerpt: ```
2026-03-15T08:11:56Z ERROR notify.orchestrator deliver_to_team infra - no_oncall_mapping_found
2026-03-15T08:11:56Z DEBUG oncall-client GET /v1/teams/infra/rotation -> 200 {}
2026-03-15T08:12:01Z ERROR notifier queue failed: delivery_error: "no targets for policy infra-primary"
```

incident-bot: automated message: created incident draft id=inc-20260315-0899 (not posted to channel due to missing routing).

sarah: so the incident draft existed but the automation that creates the channel couldn't decide where to route because the mapping was blank. that explains no channel + no phone pages. Emma — did you get a soft page or SMS?

emma (oncall): nothing. Only an email from monitoring at 08:18 after the alert threshold retriggered.

mike: customer impact: one customer reported degraded inference throughput for ~6m before manual escalation. Ticket opened by CS.

ops-sre: quick mitigation — i've pushed a manual fallback: `/oncall reload-cache infra` and then forced the notifier to use escalation policy `pager-fallback`. doing that now.

ops-sre: command output: ```
> /oncall reload-cache infra
cache: evicted key oncall:infra, refreshed from provider -> rotation:emma, phone:+1-555-1212
> notifier switch-policy infra -> pager-fallback (force=true)
notifier: delivery started to +1-555-1212, slack:@emma
```

emma (oncall): got the manual page at 08:22, acknowledged.

josh: root cause candidate: oncall-service returned 200 with empty body for teams that had recently had alias changes. the notifier treats empty body as "no mapping" and suppresses channel creation.

sarah: live mitigation steps we took: reload cache, force fallback policy, manual phone escalation, open CS ticket. Do we want to call customers who were impacted? 

mike: yes — CS has the list; recommend outreach for any customer with >5% error spike or >3m sustained degradation.

ops-sre: temporary config change proposed: make notifier allow fallback to 'oncall-email' channel when rotation mapping is empty, and alert ops with higher priority rather than silent suppression. I'll open a PR.

josh: also adding a guard: if oncall-client returns 200 but body empty, retry 3x with exponential backoff before treating as no mapping. That should cut down missed pages during race windows.

incident-bot: automated note appended: incident draft inc-20260315-0899 - status: triaged, mitigation_in_progress, owners: ops-sre, josh.

sarah: for postmortem — we need timeline (monitoring alert -> failed delivery -> manual reload -> customer reports), impact assessment from CS, and a follow-up to change notifier logic + add metrics for oncall-cache-empty events. assign to eng-oncall for the fix.

mike: i'll coordinate follow-up and write the incident summary. tagging @eng-oncall and @customer-success in the doc.

emma (oncall): thanks team. tiny ask: add an oncall cache-health heartbeat to the ops dashboard so we see empty-mapping events in real time.

ops-sre: noted. action items I'm filing: [1] PR for fallback channel policy, [2] retry/backoff for oncall-client, [3] dashboard metric for empty mappings, [4] customer outreach plan.

sarah: closing the thread for live mitigation — keep updates in the incident draft. postmortem due EOD tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
